messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

function.name: connectBluetooth

message.content:
Here’s a quick rundown of the public holidays in Canada for 2023 that typically create long weekends (i.e., holidays falling on a Friday or Monday, or a holiday that falls on a weekday but is observed on the nearest weekend day). Keep in mind that some provinces have additional holidays, so you might want to double‑check provincial calendars if your app needs province‑specific data.

| Date | Day | Holiday | Notes |
|------|-----|---------|-------|
| **January 1** | Sunday | New Year’s Day | Observed on Monday, Jan 2 |
| **January 16** | Monday | Family Day (Alberta, Saskatchewan, Ontario) | |
| **February 20** | Monday | Louis Riel Day (Manitoba) | |
| **March 20** | Monday | Good Friday | |
| **April 7** | Monday | Easter Monday (Quebec, New Brunswick, Nova Scotia, Prince Edward Island) | |
| **May 22** | Monday | Victoria Day | |
| **June 19** | Monday | National Indigenous Peoples Day (British Columbia, Yukon) | |
| **July 1** | Saturday | Canada Day | Observed on Monday, July 3 |
| **August 7** | Monday | Civic Holiday (most provinces) | |
| **September 18** | Monday | Labour Day | |
| **October 9** | Monday | Thanksgiving (Canada) | |
| **November 10** | Monday | Remembrance Day (observed on Monday) | |
| **December 25** | Monday | Christmas Day | |
| **December 26** | Tuesday | Boxing Day | |

### Long Weekend Highlights (2023)

| Holiday | Typical Long Weekend |
|---------|----------------------|
| New Year’s Day | Jan 1 (Sunday) → Observed Mon 2 |
| Family Day | Jan 16 (Monday) |
| Good Friday | Mar 20 (Friday) |
| Victoria Day | May 22 (Monday) |
| National Indigenous Peoples Day | Jun 19 (Monday) |
| Canada Day | Jul 1 (Saturday) → Observed Mon 3 |
| Civic Holiday | Aug 7 (Monday) |
| Labour Day | Sep 18 (Monday) |
| Thanksgiving | Oct 9 (Monday) |
| Remembrance Day | Nov 10 (Monday) |
| Christmas & Boxing Day | Dec 25–26 (Mon–Tue) |

If you’re building an app that needs province‑specific holidays (e.g., St. Patrick’s Day in Newfoundland & Labrador, St. John’s Day in Prince Edward Island, etc.), you’ll want to pull those from a dedicated API or database. For a general Canadian holiday list, the table above covers the major federal holidays that usually generate long weekends.
